evidence.title: GitHub - rdev/liquid-glass-react: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React

name: Liquid Glass React
summary: React component that recreates Apple's Liquid Glass effect with refraction, blur, chromatic aberration and elasticity.
description: A React glass component: proper edgy bending and refraction, configurable frost, saturation, chromatic aberration, padding, corner radius and elasticity, with hover and click effects. Wraps arbitrary children (cards, buttons) and supports four refraction modes (standard, polar, prominent, shader); the displacement effect does not render in Safari and Firefox.
contains: single glass component wrapping arbitrary child elements
props: displacement, blur, saturation, chromatic aberration, elasticity, corner radius, padding, refraction mode
refraction modes: standard, polar, prominent, shader
examples: glass card and glass button
